software.sequence_cycle_definition: Common warmup W=4 encodes pool frames 0..3; timed section encodes N frames starting at logical sequence index 4 using pool[(4 + i) % unique_cycle] for both UpstreamCpuEncodeSample and all HyperCine GPU modes without restarting at frame 0 after warmup (1080p: N=1000, cycle=96; 4K_UHD: N=300, cycle=36; 8K_UHD: N=120, cycle=12).

default_auto_policy.policy_distinction: DefaultAuto is the canonical balanced/default runtime policy used for all headline benchmarks. UserOverride is an explicit manual tuning/experimentation policy used only in the separate Manual Slot Scaling / Throughput Tuning Study.
default_auto_policy.source_code_rationale: SelectPhase2DFrameSlots computes per_slot_vram_bytes = 20*px + 4,718,592 and session_workspace_vram_bytes = 12*px + 33,554,432, caps vram_max_slots to 75% of free VRAM after a 256 MiB + workspace reserve, and under DefaultAuto clamps a resolution-bucket target_slots hardcoded during Phase 2D empirical tuning (target_slots=2 for <=1080p, target_slots=3 for <=4K UHD, target_slots=2 for >4K UHD / 8K UHD). It does not dynamically optimize slot counts per GPU SKU at runtime.

resolutions.policy_reason: Hardcoded Phase 2D DefaultAuto target_slots=2 for px<=1920x1080 (clamped by vram_max_slots); FrameConsolidated D2H selected under Throughput policy.
Hardcoded Phase 2D DefaultAuto target_slots=3 for 1080p<px<=3840x2160 (clamped by vram_max_slots); FrameConsolidated D2H selected under Throughput policy.
Hardcoded Phase 2D DefaultAuto target_slots=2 for px>3840x2160 (8K UHD, clamped by vram_max_slots); FrameConsolidated D2H selected under Throughput policy.

compared_fields: unmasked_sample_sha256 across GPU modes in deterministic verification mode

cpu_baseline_note: Baseline 1 is pristine CFHD_EncodeSample with _THREADED_ENCODER=0 and one encode thread. Baseline 2, the HyperCine CPU reference inside VerifyPhase3ASequence120, is an equivalence oracle using the upstream spatial wavelet and CPU entropy. It is not a second throughput product, so speedups use Baseline 1 only.
device_input_note: DeviceInput measures GPU-resident integration throughput when BGRA frames are already in device memory; it must never be presented as conventional file-transcode performance.

slot_scaling_study_summary.study_name: Manual Slot Scaling / Throughput Tuning Study
slot_scaling_study_summary.note: The canonical benchmark uses the encoder's DefaultAuto slot policy. The slot-scaling study intentionally overrides that policy to measure throughput/latency/VRAM trade-offs and is not the public headline configuration.
